title: ORCHID: Organic Rate-based CHarge-hopping and Integrated Device simulator
description: ORCHID simulates charge and exciton transport in disordered organic semiconductors across scales: hopping rates (Miller-Abrahams, Marcus, Marcus-Levich-Jortner, Forster, Dexter), kinetic Monte Carlo and master-equation solvers, extended Gaussian disorder mobility laws, and drift-diffusion device models for OLEDs, organic solar cells and single-carrier diodes, with transfer-matrix optics. Device KMC couples charges and excitons with quenching and annihilation, and every module is validated against analytical limits or published results.
